messages:
maria: getting a flood of apiserver 503s in eu-west1 around 17:02. etcd p99 commit latency shot up to ~3s during a GPU scale-up batch
ajay: are the gpu-provisioner jobs spiking at the same time?
infra-bot: ALERT: etcd.p99_commit_latency > 2000ms (cluster=eu-west1) — triggered 17:02:12
olivia: running quick check: `etcdctl --endpoints=https://10.2.1.4:2379,https://10.2.1.5:2379 endpoint status --write-out table`
olivia: ```
ENDPOINT           ID                 VERSION  DB SIZE  IS LEADER  RAFT TERM  RAFT INDEX
10.2.1.4:2379      9d3f2c1a          3.5.2    12 MB    true       128        543210
10.2.1.5:2379      a7b1e33f          3.5.2    11 MB    false      128        543205
```
samir: I also see kernel logs from the nodes doing GPU attach: `kernel: netlink: event NLMSG_DONE flood from vf-attach` — repeated netlink notifications can stall netpoll and scheduler briefly
maria: netlink? that's a weird one. are we hitting high concurrency for VF/SRIOV attach during the batch?
ajay: yes, provisioner ran ~120 attach ops across eu-west1 in 90s. we've seen netlink storms in lab with parallel VF binds before (causes kernel softirq spikes)
olivia: controller-manager logs show repeated lease renewal retries around the same window and then a short-lived panic in one replica: `E1207 17:02:14 controller-manager lease renew failed: rpc error: code = DeadlineExceeded`
maria: aborting the remaining attach jobs for that wave — pausing cluster-autoscaler/gpu-provisioner for eu-west1 (manual pause)
infra-bot: ACTION: gpu-provisioner queue paused for eu-west1 by @maria at 17:03:02
ajay: can we rate-limit concurrent attaches? even 10/sec would smooth this without hurting onboarding much
samir: we should also increase netlink backoff and add jitter on the provisioner side. filing a follow-up but short-term mitigation is throttling attach concurrency + moving control-plane traffic to unaffected AZs
olivia: rolling restart of controller-manager canary started: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/controller-manager -n kube-system --selector=canary=true`
maria: after pausing attaches and the canary restart, etcd p99 dropped to ~60ms in 90s and apiserver 503s cleared
infra-bot: RESOLVED ALERT: etcd.p99_commit_latency back to baseline at 17:05:36
ajay: nice. can we add a safety cap in the provisioner config: max_concurrent_vf_attach_per_az=20 ?
samir: will create JIRA INFRA-3141 to add cap + backoff + metric for netlink softirq, and a presubmit test that simulates concurrent attaches
maria: also adding runbook note and a brief postmortem. runbook link: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/etcd-commit-latency (internal)
olivia: follow-up task: schedule kernel bump on gpu nodes in eu-west to include netlink improvements, and test SR-IOV attach under load in staging
maria: thanks all. tagging @oncall for visibility in the postmortem
samir: :thumbsup: filing ticket now and will loop in platform for a configuration rollout
